text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"—Dear Stay Gold. I am an ordinary office 
worker living in a humble countryside 
town. I always watch your races on TV..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Stay Gold. When I 
handed it over in the trainer's office, 
she happily began reading it right away.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly grateful. There are so many 
passionate words of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Also, a little life story from the sender. 
Said they live far from the racetrack, but 
it's a really nice place.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A humble countryside, huh... A place like 
that sounds nice, too...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Wanna go check it out for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: âWe made it...! Whoa, it's so peaceful~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where should we start? Looks 
like those hidden gem sightseeing spots 
and local gourmet shops mentioned in the 
letter are nearby too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Of course it will. After all, it's a place 
my fans love. It's gotta be great. Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether she was serious or joking, it was 
probably half and half. And so, I ended up 
traveling around to various places with 
her.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! It's so spacious.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Looks delish~

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~~~, sure did a lot of walking. It 
really was a nice town, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there's something interesting over 
there too...! Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I started walking... I caught 
sight of a surprised passerby in the 
middle of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Stego-san?! ...No way she'd be in a 
place like this, huh. My heart totally 
skipped a beat for a second... Teehee♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What happened? I thought we got 
separated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I mentioned that I had just passed someone 
who seemed to be a Stay Gold fan. They 
left right away, but maybe that person 
was—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's a fan who sent a letter"...? 
What does she mean?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If that were true, that'd be fun. I 
would've liked to thank them at least.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Watching over such a whimsical journey... 
They really are a curious bunch, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, only God knows the truth behind 
that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She began walking again. Her steps were, 
as always, whimsical like the wind, 
perhaps occasionally stirring someone's 
heart... or so it seemed.
